property_summary: General rule: Calling Collect never changes MinSum; the mutant which subtracts from MinSum in SetMinSum can lead to MinSum changing after interactions (via Initialized/SetMinSum/Collect sequence) so there exist inputs where MinSum differs after Collect.

For any fuzzed inputs used to initialize MinSum via SetMinSum and then calling Collect, the reference contract C ensures MinSum remains equal to the value previously set (Collect does not change MinSum); the mutant that uses `MinSum -= _val` in SetMinSum can make MinSum differ after Collect for some fuzzed inputs because the mutated setter can underflow or produce a different stored MinSum value that subsequent interactions reveal.

For all admissible inputs: after initializing MinSum via SetMinSum(x) (before Initialized()), MinSum equals x and remains unchanged by later Collect(...) calls; the mutant's changed SetMinSum (MinSum -= x) can make MinSum different from x and thus differ after Collect for some fuzzed x.

For any fuzzed values used to set MinSum (via SetMinSum) and then calling Collect, the reference contract preserves MinSum equal to the originally set value (Collect does not change MinSum); the mutant's changed SetMinSum (which subtracts from MinSum) can make MinSum differ, so there exist fuzzed inputs where MinSum observed after Collect differs between reference and mutant.

For any fuzzed inputs used to initialize the contract, calling SetMinSum(x) sets MinSum to x and subsequent calls to Collect(...) do not change MinSum; the mutant's changed SetMinSum (which subtracts the provided value) can make MinSum differ and thus will violate this invariant for some fuzzed x and call sequence.

After initializing MinSum to a nonzero value via SetMinSum and calling Initialized, the contract's MinSum getter returns that same nonzero value (i.e. SetMinSum stores the provided value unless already initialized).

For every uint _val the reference contract sets MinSum equal to the supplied _val; the mutant doubles it so there exist inputs where MinSum != supplied value (i.e., MinSum == _val always for reference, but not for mutant).

Reference contract: after any sequence where an account does a zero-value Put (via Put(0) fallback or Put with 0 value) and then Collect(...) the stored per-account balance never increases due to Collect — specifically, Collect only decreases balance when conditions met; the mutant disallows zero-value Put (require msg.value>0) so sequences that rely on zero-value Put to set/extend unlockTime or to log a Put without changing balance are rejected, making state reachable differences (acc.balance and unlockTime) possible — the property asserts that calling Collect never increases the caller's recorded balance (acc.balance after Collect <= acc.balance before Collect) which holds for reference for all inputs but is violated by the mutant for some inputs.
